title: V08 Tier 1 qualification of the integrated Cognous OCS authority-to-effect boundary

independence.statement: Independent test design within the same engineering organization. NOT independent external qualification. It does NOT satisfy Plan v1.5 V08 'independent lead and oracle' or the rule 'no AI-as-independent qualification'. Plan status 'Independent Tier 1: NOT STARTED' is therefore unchanged by this PR.

lead_builder.identity: AI session (Claude Sonnet 5.5) that wrote the Runtime V05 guard, the V06 harness, the V07 harness and the F-01 patch

workers.identity: short-lived AI sessions (Claude Sonnet 5.5) started with no conversation history
workers.prior_implementation_involvement: none in conversation context; same model family and organization as the lead; they read the same frozen sources
workers.rule: design cases and oracles from the frozen contracts and component source first; commit the case inventory; only then read existing tests (for fixture mechanics, never for assertions)

budget.counting: every execution including reruns and each parametrized case; enforced per area by a ledger (V08_BUDGET_ENFORCE=1); GitHub CI is a separate gate

rules: workers never edit another owner's files, shared workflows, component source, or the pins
no shared SQLite database, anchor file, temp dir or evidence dir between workers
workers do not merge or push the PR branch; each commits to its own local branch and reports

verdict_vocabulary.HELD: the attack failed / invariant held / legitimate path worked
verdict_vocabulary.BREACH: the secure oracle was violated (preserve the reproduction, identify the owner, stop that workstream)
verdict_vocabulary.CHARACTERIZED: documented, contract-defined limitation observed and recorded
verdict_vocabulary.INCONCLUSIVE: the case did not exercise what it set out to (never a pass)
verdict_vocabulary.BLOCKED: a mandatory path could not be exercised (never a pass)

authority.scenario: Control Plane WORKFLOW-ISSUED claim (aligned synthetic tenant, institution, authority domain; actual materialization, not the model commitment function) carried through the Runtime effect guard
valid strictly narrower and equal policy execute; one effect, one receipt
five-set F1a widening, each set independently, including claim-supplier collusion (recomputed commitment)
stale activation and stale policy generation refuse
withdrawal and revocation (selection, epoch pair, issuer key) refuse
required-scope legacy / binding-less bypass refuses; permitted ungoverned legacy still works
binding / scope-member substitution (tenant, institution, authority domain, operation) refuses
Registry selection / record authenticity as seen by the Runtime

atomicity.scenario: cross-process revocation race with deterministic ordering (distinct OS processes)
concurrent effect attempts on one claim and on a shared budget (distinct OS processes)
transaction-critical evidence-write failure leaves zero effects
crash at each transaction stage (distinct OS process killed): no partial effect, retry semantics
corrupted / missing durable authority fails closed
failure-atomic refusal: a refusal leaves no partial rows

trust.scenario: trust snapshot validity, expiry and high-water
missing verifier / dependency handling fails closed
provenance and evidence integrity (no false provenance claims; evidence matches durable state)
re-examine the documented V07 LOW findings (A09 caller-owned amount/prefix, D08 unauthenticated claim_json, D01 consistent rollback, I01 wrapper pin) and residual assumptions

acceptance: mandatory scenarios execute successfully; a mandatory scenario that cannot run is BLOCKED and is not a pass
no unauthorized effect, policy widening, authority bypass or revocation bypass (P0)
no fail-open corruption, no rollback acceptance contrary to the frozen contract, no broken atomicity (P1)
transaction-critical evidence failure prevents the effect; no false provenance (P2)
cross-process atomicity demonstrated with distinct OS processes
Control Plane issuance-to-Runtime path tested, or classified as an unresolved qualification blocker
worker evidence retained and traceable; each worker's inventory commit precedes its results
required GitHub CI passes; no critical or high finding unresolved; independence limits disclosed
stop_conditions: a mandatory invariant fails: preserve the reproduction, name the owning component, stop that workstream, do not repair, do not change component code
budget exhausted: stop local execution and report unqualified cases
